# @three-ws/intel-mcp

> three.ws market intelligence from any AI agent — smart-money scoring, wallet intel, signal feeds, KOL leaderboards/trades, and the copy-trade Smart Money directory. Read-only over the live public API. No key, no signer, no payment.

@three-ws/intel-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/intel-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/intel-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/intel-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/intel-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/intel-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
